subject: Post-call: commercial payment path, procurement readiness & budget owner mapping — Aurelia Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace Wilkinson <grace.wilkinson@aureliahealth.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@aureliahealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + asks: payment path, approvals, and next steps

Hi Grace / Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we captured on the call: 

- Objective: pilot Redwood for LLM-enabled discharge summaries in 6 clinics (proof of cost/latency) then expand to 40+ sites.
- Key commercial question: preferred billing flow (PO + invoice vs. corporate card / marketplace) and estimated procurement lead time.
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 report + data-retention/audit logs for PHI-adjacent workloads.
- Decision makers we heard on the call: Dr. Maya Patel (budget owner / clinical sponsor), Samir Khan (finance sponsor), CFO Elena Torres (signatory). Please confirm.

Requested next items from your side: 
1) Confirm preferred billing method (PO vs card vs marketplace).
2) Confirm final list of approvers and the person who will sign the MSA/SOW.
3) Any internal procurement form we should complete (if yes, attach).

From our side we will: 
- Share a concise pricing matrix for PO vs card (attached: RWI-MAP-Aurelia-0926.xlsx — mutual action plan + high-level pricing).
- Prepare a short SOC2 evidence bundle and a one-page deployment/compliance summary.
- Propose 2 commercial paths (fast card pilot for dev + standard PO for production).

Proposed next milestone: 30-minute sync with the budget owner and CFO next week to walk the commercial options and timeline. Please propose two 30-minute windows.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Grace Wilkinson <grace.wilkinson@aureliahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@aureliahealth.com>, procurement@aureliahealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks: payment path, approvals, and next steps

Thanks Karthik — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Billing: our standard preference for vendor agreements at this scale is PO + Net 30 invoicing for production. We are interested in a card-based pilot for the initial dev test environment if Redwood can support separate billing for the pilot vs production. We are also evaluating marketplace procurement for speed, but that requires procurement and IT approval.
- Approvers: confirming internal owners — Dr. Maya Patel (budget owner, m.patel@aureliahealth.com), Samir Khan (finance sponsor), and likely Elena Torres (CFO) will be the signatory for agreements over $250k. Procurement inbox is procurement@aureliahealth.com.
- Timeline: typical PO routing for a new vendor is 4–6 weeks (procurement intake, vendor onboarding, legal/insurance review). If we go marketplace it can shave 2–3 weeks but may involve additional marketplace fees.

Procurement would like the following artifacts to start their intake: our SOC 2 Type II, certificate of insurance, and a short SOW + estimated monthly spend. I attached our internal procurement intake form for vendor onboarding (Aurelia_Procurement_Form.pdf).

For a next step, I can coordinate a 30-minute meeting with Dr. Patel and Samir on Thursday 9/17 between 11:00–12:00 ET or Friday 9/18 14:00–15:00 ET. Which works for you?

Best,
Grace

--
Grace Wilkinson
Director, Clinical Innovation | Aurelia Health Systems
grace.wilkinson@aureliahealth.com | +1 (617) 222-3344
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: action items for Aurelia — pricing + procurement pack

Karthik / Diego — quick internal coordination following Grace's reply. Suggested plan / owners: 

1) Karthik: confirm meeting slot (I prefer Thu 9/17 11:00 ET). Invite Dr. Patel + Samir + Elena if available.
2) Diego: assemble SOC2 evidence packet (SOC2 attestation, security one-pager, retention/audit log notes) and upload to Drive. Also prepare a 1-page note on private vs hosted (data flows + PHI considerations).
3) Marissa (me): produce a 2-column pricing brief showing PO vs card economics (attached: pricing-PO-vs-card-brief.pdf) and note marketplace fees/lead time. Add estimated procurement lead times and legal turnaround (best case 2 weeks, normal 4–6 weeks).

A couple of commercial asks to prep for the call: 
- A clear routing suggestion: start with a 3-month card-funded dev pilot (small CC), then sign a PO-backed MSA for production expansion; include an express marketplace option if they want a shorter path.
- Prepare a stub SOW with DocuSign link we can send on the call if the CFO is ready to sign.

Diego — can you confirm SOC2 upload and drop the Drive link in a reply?

Marissa
